name: High School Volunteers, St. David's Georgetown Hospital
what_you_do: Volunteer in hospital departments for 3 to 4 hours a week during the summer program (up to 8 weeks). A few students are also accepted during the year.
who_can_apply: High school students 15 and older who can work on their own after training. Year round spots are few. They mostly go to homeschool, hybrid or similar students.
duration: 3 to 4 hours a week, up to 8 weeks in summer
deadline_text: Summer session dates and deadlines are not listed on the page I read.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application. You get an email in 24 to 48 hours with next steps. They are an interview with the Student Volunteer Committee, a background check, a drug test and shot records. Call 512-942-4777 or email sdghvolunteers@hcahealthcare.com.
notes: Georgetown is in Williamson County, north of Round Rock. Shifts can be evenings and weekends. Vaccines listed: flu, Tdap within 10 years, TB, 2 MMR and 2 chickenpox or history.
